introHtml: Tekweld jar openers combine durable zinc alloy construction with a wide range of die-cast shapes, from classic circles to novelty piggy and house designs. These openers offer a solid, weighty feel that communicates quality at trade shows and employee appreciation events. With options for full-color imprinting on the flat face, your logo stands out clearly on every piece. Choose Tekweld for a reliable, USA-made promotional product that recipients will keep on their keychains or countertops.
